spans.s: (I)--followed सती going to दक्ष's sacrifice. भा.
(II)--a son of Kali and सुरा. Br. III. ५९. 9; वा. ८४. 9.
(III)--born out of the अहन्कार of ब्रह्मा.

(I)--a name of काम, God of Love: also Makaradhvaja (s.v.);
1: भा.

. २४-9; ११. 7.
performed सौभाग्य--शयनम्;
3: M. ६०. ४९.
at the request of the Devas and persecuted by तारक, Madana took courage and secretly entered शिव's abode; the latter grew angry and burnt him with his third eye;
4: Br. IV. ११. २८.
remembered by Indra, went to him and was ordered to create sexual desire in शिव; he got frightened at शिव's third eye, but pressed by Indra he agreed to meet the Lord and sent his arrow of Mohana when Siva's third eye burnt him down; Rati wept with Madhu or Spring and both went to शिव; Rati praised him for grace; शिव replied that Madana would attain fame as Ananga in the world sometime hence.
5: M. १५४. २१२-51, २६०-70.
--a commander of भण्ड sent to aid विषन्ग. Br. IV. २१. ७८; २५. २७.
--the vow observed on the १२थ् day of the bright half of Caitra, with the object of attaining sons; observed by दिती.
--the queen of सन्दास; gave birth to अश्मक through वसिष्ठ with the assent of the King; prevented her husband from returning the curse on वसिष्ठ. भा.
(I)--one of Vasudeva's wives and mother of Nanda and other sons. भा. IX. २४. ४५, ४८. Br. III. ७१. १६१, १७१-2. वा. ९६. १६०, Vi. IV. १५. १८, २३.

(II)--came out of the churning of the ocean of milk.
1: M. २५१. 2.
बलराम indulged in.
2: Vi. IV. १३. १५७.
--also सुरासिन्धु, सिन्धुराज, सुराम्- budhi, सुधाम्बुधि: a deity in the Kiricakraratha. Br. IV. २०. ७३; २८. ५७, ६२, ८७-8.
--Liquor: Brahmanas forbidden to take it: प्रायस्चित्त for it: used in the worship of the mother goddess and the शक्तिस्. Br.
--an ancient tribe: enlisted by जरासन्ध against the Yadus, their king went to स्यमन्तपञ्चक for the solar eclipse M. २०८. 5; भा. X. [५४ (V) 4] ८२. १३.
--a son of शिबि; Kingdom of, माद्रकस्. भा. IX. २३. 3; Br. III. ७४. २३; Vi. IV. १८. १०. वा. ९९. २३-24.

--a tribe; turned into a ruling caste by पुरञ्जय;
1: M. ११४. ४१; भा.

. ३६.
followed भीम in his conquests;
2: Ib. X. ७२. १३.
established by विश्वस्फाणि.
3: Br. III. ७४. १९१.
--ruled by पुरूरवस् in the चाक्षुषमन्- vantara. M. ११५. 7; ११८. ४८ and ७७.
(I)--one of the ten wives of Atri: mother of Soma. Br.
(II)--a R. originating from the Vindhyas. वा. ४५. १०२.
(III)--a daughter of घृताची and भद्राश्व. वा. ७०. ६८. [page२-609+ ३२]
(IV)--one of the ten daughters of रौद्राश्व. वा. ९९. १२५.
--in Duryodhana's army: went to Syamanta- पञ्चक for the solar eclipse. भा. X. ७८. [९५ (V) १६]; ८२. २६.

--(माद्री) one of the two wives of पाण्डु, gave birth to two twins, Nakula and Sahadeva by the grace of अश्विन्स्. भा. IX. २२. २८; Br. III. ७१. १५५; M. ४६. १०; ५०. ४८; वा. ९६. १५४; ९९. २४३; वा. ९९. २४३; Vi. IV. १४. ३७-8; २०-40.
(II)--one of the wives of दृष्टि; her sons were युधाजित्, मिधराम्स, Animitra and शिनी. Br. III. ७१. १८-19.
(III)--the second wife of वृष्णि; gave birth to five sons, युधाजित् (देवमिढुष), Anamitra, etc. M. ४
(IV)--a queen of कृष्ण; mother of वृक and other sons. M. ४७. १४; वा. ९६. २३४; Vi. V. ३२. 4.
(V)--the mother of Suhotra by Sahadeva, the पाण्डव. M. ५०. ५५. [page२-682+ २५]
